theme_and_identity.description: A dense, high-performance banking ops workshop. Avoids generic enterprise tables. Prioritizes spatial memory, rapid keyboard navigation, and immediate error resolution.

1_what_to_keep: The 'Mission Control' dark aesthetic (#0A0A0A, Cyan, Blue).
Clickable KPI indicators acting as active filters.
Discreet autosave and functional animations (no full reloads).
2_what_an_expert_would_do_differently: Density & Architecture: A generic flex-row list fails at 100 items. Shrinking from 12 to 7 columns when the Inspector opens causes catastrophic layout shifts and loss of spatial memory.
Drawer Collision: A 440px right drawer for the Catalog conflicts with the right-side Inspector, causing UI claustrophobia.
Aurora Bar Collision: Floating an AI bar AND a bulk-action bar simultaneously at the bottom creates visual pollution.
Status Hierarchy: Badges are decorative. In ops, errors must dictate row priority and offer immediate contextual fixes, not just a red label.
Stepper Dominance: A large horizontal stepper wastes critical vertical real estate needed for the data queue.
3_concrete_proposals_and_priorities: Priority 1 (Layout Stability): Implement a permanent 12-column grid. Queue takes 8 cols, Inspector takes 4 cols. If no item is selected, the 4 cols show an elegant empty state. Zero layout shifting.
Priority 2 (The Catalog): Replace the right-drawer Catalog with a ⌘K Command Palette overlay (Spotlight style). It is temporary, keyboard-first, and preserves workspace.
Priority 3 (Morphing Action Bar): Merge the bottom bars. The Aurora AI pill morphs seamlessly into a wide Batch Actions glass bar when checkboxes are selected.
Priority 4 (Error Context): Use left-border color coding on rows for status. In the Inspector, errors must feature an inline 'Action Corrective' block.
Priority 5 (Compact Header): Move the stepper into the persistent header as a compact Breadcrumb (e.g., 'Meridian Twin / Step 2: Sources').

rules: CRITICAL: All numbers, metrics, and timestamps MUST use IBM Plex Mono to ensure tabular alignment.
Headings must use tracking-tight to look sharp, not playful.
Small labels (overline) must be uppercase with tracking-widest.

spacing_and_layout.strategy: The Bento Grid Protocol (Mode B: High Density Grid)
spacing_and_layout.queue_density: Tight vertical spacing (py-2, gap-2). Every pixel is utilized for scanning efficiency.
spacing_and_layout.surfaces: Retro-Futurism / Terminal look. 1px solid borders (`border-white/10`), no soft shadows on flat elements. Glassmorphism reserved strictly for floating components.

components.persistent_header: Fixed top, backdrop-blur-md bg-[#0A0A0A]/80. Contains Breadcrumb Stepper (Left), Twin Name (Center), Autosave/Exit (Right).
components.kpi_filters: 4 interactive blocks. Layout: Massive Mono number above small uppercase label. Active state gets a 1px cyan border and 10% cyan bg.
components.source_queue: Grid-based list. Collapsible group headers (sticky). Rows have 1px left-border colored by status. Columns: Checkbox | Name (bold) | Meta (mono 10px) | Status | Date.
components.adaptive_inspector: Sticky right column. Adaptive form. Top of inspector highlights status. If error, display a tinted alert box with a primary 'Fix' CTA.
components.command_palette_catalog: Replaces the drawer. Centered floating overlay (`backdrop-blur-xl`). Search input auto-focused. Keyboard navigable list of connectors.
components.aurora_morph_bar: Floating pill at bottom center. Default: AI Copilot. When rows selected: Framer Motion animates it expanding into Batch Actions (Delete, Verify, Group).

motion_and_interactions.row_hover: Background shifts to surface_secondary, slight right translation (translateX(2px)) for the row action icon.
motion_and_interactions.aurora_morph: Layout animation transitioning width and border-radius from a pill to a wide toolbar.
motion_and_interactions.inspector_enter: Fade and slight slide-up (`y: 10 -> 0`) for content inside the 4-col container.
motion_and_interactions.palette_enter: Scale up (`scale: 0.95 -> 1`) with backdrop fade in.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement the layout using a strict 12-column grid. Do NOT shrink the list to 7 columns dynamically.
Build a centralized Command Palette (`⌘K`) for the Catalog instead of a side drawer.
Combine the AI Aurora bar and Batch Actions into a single morphing Framer Motion component.
Use IBM Plex Mono for all numerical data, IDs, and timestamps. Use Space Grotesk strictly for high-level headings.
Ensure all clickable elements have semantic HTML tags and `data-testid` attributes.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) ONLY for floating overlays (Palette, Batch Bar).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., `transition: all`). Add transitions for specific properties to prevent breaking transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. Keep natural left-aligned reading flows for data.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, entrance animations. Static = dead.
Subtle grain textures, custom selection states: separates good from extraordinary.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute.
